request: how do you change 36 km/h into metres per second?

beats.intent: A distance line with a car covering 36 km in one hour
beats.narration: A cyclist at thirty six kilometres an hour covers thirty six kilometres in one hour.
beats.code:
stage.title("km/h to m/s")
dist = NumberLine(x_range=[0, 36000, 6000], length=10).move_to([0, 0.9, 0])
stage.play(Create(dist))
stage.add(dist)
car = Square(0.3, color=RED, fill_opacity=0.9).move_to(dist.n2p(0) + 0.3 * UP)
stage.play(FadeIn(car))
stage.play(car.animate.move_to(dist.n2p(36000) + 0.3 * UP), run_time=1.5, rate_func=linear)
stage.add(car)
stage.label(dist, "36 km = 36 000 m", direction=UP, color=YELLOW)

beats.intent: A time line underneath: one hour = 3600 seconds
beats.narration: In metres that's thirty six thousand. And one hour is sixty times sixty: three thousand six hundred seconds.
beats.code:
time = NumberLine(x_range=[0, 3600, 600], length=10).move_to([0, -0.9, 0])
stage.play(Create(time))
stage.add(time)
stage.label(time, "1 hour = 3600 s", direction=DOWN, color=BLUE)

beats.intent: The first sixth of each line matched: 6000 m in 600 s, so 10 m every second
beats.narration: Match the lines up piece by piece: six thousand metres in six hundred seconds. Every second, ten metres.
beats.code:
seg_d = Line(dist.n2p(0), dist.n2p(6000), color=YELLOW, stroke_width=8)
seg_t = Line(time.n2p(0), time.n2p(600), color=BLUE, stroke_width=8)
link = DashedLine(seg_d.get_end(), seg_t.get_end(), color=GREY_B)
stage.play(Create(seg_d), Create(seg_t), Create(link))
stage.add(seg_d, seg_t, link)
stage.label(link, "6000 m in 600 s", direction=RIGHT, color=GREEN)

beats.intent: The lines beside 36 000 ÷ 3600 = 10 m/s and the shortcut 36 ÷ 3.6 = 10
beats.narration: Thirty six thousand metres over three thousand six hundred seconds is ten metres per second. The shortcut: divide kilometres per hour by three point six.

request: how do you take your pulse by counting for 15 seconds?

beats.narration: Press two fingers on your wrist and watch a clock for fifteen seconds.
beats.code:
stage.title("Taking a pulse")
tx = lambda t: -5 + t * 10 / 15
pts = [[tx(0), 0.6, 0]]
for i in range(18):
    t = (i + 0.5) * 15 / 18
    pts += [[tx(t - 0.12), 0.6, 0], [tx(t - 0.04), 1.8, 0], [tx(t + 0.04), 0.2, 0], [tx(t + 0.12), 0.6, 0]]
pts.append([tx(15), 0.6, 0])
trace = VMobject(color=RED, stroke_width=3).set_points_as_corners(pts)
axis = NumberLine(x_range=[0, 15, 5], length=10, include_numbers=True).move_to([0, -0.3, 0])
stage.play(Create(axis))
stage.play(Create(trace), run_time=2, rate_func=linear)
stage.add(axis, trace)
stage.label(axis, "seconds", direction=DOWN)

beats.intent: Each beat ticked off by a dot, a counter reaching 18
beats.narration: Count the beats: eighteen in fifteen seconds.
beats.code:
ticks = VGroup(*[Dot([tx((i + 0.5) * 15 / 18 - 0.04), 1.95, 0], radius=0.07, color=YELLOW) for i in range(18)])
counter = Text("0 beats", font_size=32, color=YELLOW).move_to([0, 2.6, 0])
stage.add(counter)
stage.play(LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(d) for d in ticks], lag_ratio=0.3), run_time=2)
stage.play(Transform(counter, Text("18 beats in 15 s", font_size=32, color=YELLOW).move_to(counter)))
stage.add(ticks)

beats.intent: Four 15-second blocks making a minute, each holding 18 beats
beats.narration: A minute is four lots of fifteen seconds, so a minute holds four lots of eighteen beats.
beats.code:
blocks = VGroup(*[Rectangle(width=2.4, height=0.7, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.3) for _ in range(4)]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.1).move_to([0, -2.3, 0])
stage.play(LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(b) for b in blocks], lag_ratio=0.3))
stage.add(blocks)
stage.play(*[FadeIn(Text("15 s: 18", font_size=24).move_to(b)) for b in blocks])
stage.label(blocks, "1 minute", direction=DOWN, color=BLUE)

beats.intent: The picture beside 18 × 4 = 72 beats per minute
beats.narration: Eighteen times four is seventy two beats per minute: a normal resting pulse.

request: how many litres fit in a cubic metre?

beats.intent: A 10 cm cube in the corner, labelled 1 litre
beats.narration: A litre is the space inside a cube ten centimetres on each side.
beats.code:
stage.title("Litres in a cubic metre")
s = 0.4
corner = np.array([-4.5, 1.4, 0])
cube_front = Square(s, color=YELLOW, fill_opacity=0.7).move_to(corner + np.array([s / 2, -s / 2, 0]))
cube_back = cube_front.copy().set_fill(opacity=0).shift(np.array([0.15, 0.15, 0]))
edges = VGroup(*[Line(cube_front.get_corner(c), cube_back.get_corner(c), color=YELLOW) for c in (UL, UR, DR)])
cube = VGroup(cube_back, edges, cube_front)
stage.play(Create(cube))
stage.add(cube)
lit = stage.label(cube, "1 litre: a 10 cm cube", direction=RIGHT, color=YELLOW)

beats.intent: A 1 m square face, and ten litre cubes along its top edge
beats.narration: A cubic metre is a hundred centimetres on each side, so ten of those cubes fit along one edge.
beats.code:
stage.play(FadeOut(lit))
face = Square(10 * s, color=WHITE).move_to(corner + np.array([5 * s, -5 * s, 0]))
stage.play(Create(face))
stage.add(face)
row = VGroup(*[Square(s, color=YELLOW, fill_opacity=0.5).move_to(corner + np.array([(i + 0.5) * s, -s / 2, 0])) for i in range(10)])
stage.play(LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(r) for r in row], lag_ratio=0.1))
stage.add(row)
stage.label(face, "1 m", direction=LEFT)

beats.intent: The whole face filled: 100 cubes in one layer, and ten layers going back
beats.narration: Ten rows of ten make a hundred in one layer. And the cubic metre is ten layers deep.
beats.code:
grid = VGroup(*[Square(s, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.35, stroke_width=1).move_to(corner + np.array([(i + 0.5) * s, -(j + 0.5) * s, 0])) for j in range(1, 10) for i in range(10)])
stage.play(FadeIn(grid))
stage.add(grid)
behind = VGroup(*[face.copy().set_stroke(GREY_B, 1).shift(k * np.array([0.1, 0.1, 0])) for k in range(1, 10)])
stage.play(LaggedStart(*[Create(b) for b in behind], lag_ratio=0.1))
stage.add(behind)
stage.label(VGroup(face, behind), "100 per layer × 10 layers", direction=RIGHT, color=BLUE)

beats.intent: The cube beside 10 × 10 × 10 = 1000, so 1 m³ = 1000 litres
beats.narration: Ten by ten by ten is a thousand. A cubic metre holds a thousand litres: about a tonne of water.

request: if each step is 75 cm, how many steps are there in a kilometre?

beats.intent: Two footprints 0.75 m apart above a metre ruler
beats.narration: Each of your steps covers about seventy five centimetres.
beats.code:
stage.title("Steps in a kilometre")
m = 2
x0 = -5.5
ruler = NumberLine(x_range=[0, 3, 1], length=3 * m, include_numbers=True).move_to([x0 + 1.5 * m, -1.5, 0])
stage.play(Create(ruler))
stage.add(ruler)
stage.label(ruler, "metres", direction=DOWN)
prints = VGroup(*[Ellipse(width=0.45, height=0.22, color=WHITE, fill_opacity=0.8).move_to([x0 + 0.75 * m * i, -0.3 if i % 2 else 0.1, 0]) for i in range(5)])
stage.play(FadeIn(prints[0]), FadeIn(prints[1]))
stage.add(prints[0], prints[1])
step = Line([x0, 0.6, 0], [x0 + 0.75 * m, 0.6, 0], color=YELLOW)
stage.play(Create(step))
stage.add(step)
stage.label(step, "0.75 m", direction=UP, color=YELLOW)

beats.intent: Four steps reaching the 3 m mark
beats.narration: Four steps take you exactly three metres.
beats.code:
stage.play(LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(p) for p in prints[2:]], lag_ratio=0.4))
stage.add(*prints[2:])
four = Line([x0, -0.9, 0], [x0 + 3 * m, -0.9, 0], color=GREEN, stroke_width=6)
stage.play(Create(four))
stage.add(four)
stage.label(four, "4 steps = 3 m", direction=RIGHT, color=GREEN)

beats.intent: A kilometre as 1000 m: how many 3 m lots, each worth 4 steps
beats.narration: A kilometre is a thousand metres: three hundred and thirty three and a third lots of three metres, and each lot is four steps.
beats.code:
km = Text("1000 m ÷ 3 m ≈ 333.3 lots", font_size=30, color=BLUE).move_to([-2.5, 2.2, 0])
stage.play(FadeIn(km))
stage.add(km)

beats.narration: So a kilometre is about one thousand three hundred and thirty three steps: a thousand divided by nought point seven five.
